expectations.text: Identifies Ireland, Spain and France as the member states still lacking in-force transposition laws as of early September 2026
expectations.evidence: I can't give you a definitive, current-as-of-September-2026 list... 'I cannot confirm whether this bill had been enacted' — never identifies IE/ES/FR as the remaining laggards

expectations.text: Cites the July 9, 2026 Commission referral to the CJEU for failure to notify transposition — which originally also included the Netherlands
expectations.evidence: No mention of the July 9, 2026 Commission referral to the CJEU; only cites 2024-2025 formal notices under Article 258 TFEU

expectations.text: Notes the Commission requested financial penalties: a lump sum plus daily penalty payments
expectations.evidence: No mention of the Commission requesting a lump sum plus daily penalty payments

expectations.text: Notes the Netherlands has since transposed (Cbw in force August 15, 2026) and should no longer be listed as a laggard
expectations.evidence: No mention of the Dutch Cbw or the Netherlands' August 15, 2026 transposition

expectations.text: Gives the right advice: prepare subsidiaries against the directive text now — authorities have applied short compliance windows once national law lands
expectations.evidence: Advice is only to 'have local counsel or a compliance tracker... confirm current status'; no advice to build to the directive text now or warning of short compliance windows
